The price-to-book ratio of 1.05x is below the sector benchmark of 1.46x, indicating that DREAMFOLKS may be undervalued relative to its book value [E6]. Additionally, DREAMFOLKS's median return on equity over the last year at 4% is well below the sector benchmark of 4.77%, suggesting a potential mispricing in the stock [E23]. Despite these underperformances, DREAMFOLKS still offers a strong dividend yield of 19% (median over the past three years) and has maintained its market capitalization at ₹329 Cr, indicating some investor confidence despite the negative ROE [E5, E7, E22]. The stock's price-to-book ratio also suggests that DREAMFOLKS is trading below its book value, which could be a significant undervaluation. Therefore, investors should consider the potential for improvement in return on equity and re-evaluate their investment strategy given these favorable metrics.]
